Earlier studies have explored the effects of composition, processing conditions, and temperature on the properties of these alloys. Recent studies have investigated the use of computational methods, such as molecular dynamics simulations, to predict the behavior of these alloys. The trend suggests a shift towards more advanced computational methods and a greater emphasis on understanding the underlying mechanisms that control the properties of high-entropy alloys.
